item.title: INstalling and Configuring Apache Server
item.description:
Objective

To install a web server on Linux and access it from the host machine.

Practice Process

I installed Apache2 using sudo apt install apache2. Then I checked the service status using systemctl status apache2. I used curl localhost in the terminal and accessed the Apache dafault page via the virtual machine’s IP address on my host browser.

This experiment gave me a claer understanding of how websites are hosted and served.

item.title: User and Group Management in Linux
item.description:
Objective

Learn how to creat users and manage perissions, which is crucial for server security.

Practice Process

I executed the following commands:

  • sudo adduser student01
  • sudo groupadd engineering
  • sudo usermod -aG engineering student01

Understanding user groups is very helpful,especially when setting up web servers for future engineering projectd.

item.title: Linux Basic Commands Experiment
item.description:
##Objective To master the basic file management commands in the Linux terminal.

##Practice Process In this experiment, I used the VirtualBox Ubuntu environment.

  • Created a new directory using mkdir linux_lab.
  • Listed files using ls -l.
  • Changed permissions for a script using chmod +x script.sh.

This is a solid foundation for further system administration.
